worker_target_description: Study 1 apartment-choice attraction effect: focused interaction contrast comparing depletion plus placebo with the combination of depletion plus sugar, no depletion plus sugar, and no depletion plus placebo (unadjusted analysis).
worker_notes: Only assigned original effect-size and p fields examined for completion. Unassigned n, replication and success fields are placeholders. Target identification follows the explicit four-group main prediction and focused contrast, not numeric matching. We tested this prediction using a focused ... interaction contrast pitting the depletion-plus-placebo condi- ... tion against the combination of the other three conditions. The supplied canonical text OCR renders the partial eta-squared symbol as Zp 2 and equals signs as 5 or ¼; PDF p. 4 visually confirms ηp² = .045 and p_rep = .92. p_rep is not a conventional null-hypothesis p value; no conversion performed. Other analyses on p. 258 are distinct: eight-cell omnibus F(7,112)=3.67, partial eta-squared .187, p_rep=.99; apartment-set main effect F(1,119)=15.13, partial eta-squared .119, p_rep>.99; restricted and pairwise contrasts exclude some of the four groups. These are not substituted for the explicitly described focused four-group attraction-effect contrast. The covariate-adjusted contrast is on p. 259, outside the supplied p. 4 locator.
